name: research
description: Research a topic across the web, news and YouTube. Every line is a real source returned by a real backend (Agent Reach or the built-in search); results carry their links and channels, and a licensing caveat is stated when YouTube media is involved. Nothing is invented.

settings.label: Maximum sources
settings.help: How many sources to return per run.

settings.label: Include YouTube results
settings.help: Search YouTube alongside the web when the platform is not specified.

settings.label: State the media licensing caveat
settings.help: Adds a reminder that linked media belongs to its owner and reuse needs a licence.
